content.short: Arcus is a self-custodial DEX on Robinhood Chain for tokenized stocks and perpetuals.
content.description: Arcus is a self-custodial exchange on Robinhood Chain for tokenized equities, with perpetual futures in development behind a waitlist. Spot trading in stock tokens carries no fee and runs around the clock, so positions are not bound to exchange opening hours. Assets stay in the user's own wallet throughout, and the venue sources institutional liquidity for its books. The exchange was built in partnership with established trading teams.
